annotations.title: Work out what registration costs with FastCAC

description: What registering costs with FastCAC: the live all-in price for a business name (and the name reservation price), or how to get a quote for a limited company or an NGO (Incorporated Trustees). Use it for any question about what registration costs, including 'how much does CAC charge?'. It returns FastCAC's prices only, never CAC's own fees.

share_capital.description: Optional, companies only, in naira. Not needed: a company's price is a quote.

name: calculate_cac_fees

name_reservation.description: Reserving the name first; what's paid comes off the registration price.

price.description: Naira, FastCAC's all-in price (business names); null when it's a quote.

quote.description: Companies and NGOs: the team gives one price on WhatsApp.
